name: Fermata Auto
author: AndreyPavlenko
description: Full-featured audio, video, and TV player for Android Auto. Plays local video and music files, YouTube streams, and IPTV playlists (m3u/m3u8) with complete audio/video sync and media playback controls.

defaultVersions.changelog: Full ffmpeg media engine, Android 14/15/16 support, YouTube playback stability fixes.
Lightweight build, improved subtitle rendering, and IPTV playlist caching.

name: CarStream
author: theiostream
description: Stream YouTube and online videos directly to your car screen. Features account sign-in, video search, custom URLs, and desktop browser mode for parked car entertainment.

defaultVersions.changelog: Updated WebView rendering, touch fix for high DPI car displays.
Search suggestions and keyboard rendering updates.
Legacy stability release with low memory footprint.

name: Screen2Auto
author: Inceptive (annexhack)
description: Advanced smartphone screen mirroring for Android Auto. Mirrors your entire phone display with full multi-touch input, aspect ratio fitting, custom DPI scaling, and customizable app launcher.

defaultVersions.changelog: Enhanced touch latency, custom DPI profiles, and Android 13/14 compatibility.

name: AA Mirror Plus
author: Rikj000 & slashmax
description: Fork of AA Mirror with expanded features: multi-touch gesture support, automatic screen rotation, custom aspect ratio fitting, and brightness dimming during mirroring.

defaultVersions.changelog: Multi-touch gestures, auto orientation, and screen dimming.
Original AA Mirror lightweight screen mirroring.

name: AAStream
author: shmykelsa
description: High-framerate video and display streamer for Android Auto. Stream phone media apps and browser pages with low latency.

defaultVersions.changelog: Optimized audio sync and hardware decoding pipeline.

name: AA Passenger
author: Martin Soucha
description: Allows passengers to stream and control music, videos, and navigation cues onto the car's Android Auto screen without touching the driver's phone.

defaultVersions.changelog: Audio stream sync and wireless connection stability enhancements.

name: AA Browser
author: kododake
description: A full-featured Chromium-based web browser optimized for Android Auto touchscreens. Browse any website, watch HTML5 video, save bookmarks, and navigate with desktop zoom.

defaultVersions.changelog: Modern web engine updates, tab switcher, and custom bookmark manager.

name: Performance Monitor
author: jilleb
description: Real-time vehicle telemetry on your car display: turbo boost pressure, oil temperature, coolant temperature, g-meter, and live power output gauges.

defaultVersions.changelog: MQB platform telemetry support, gauge customization, and real-time logging.

name: AATorque
author: agronick
description: Displays live OBD2 engine diagnostics from Torque Pro directly on Android Auto: RPM, speed, gear, fuel flow, intake temperatures, and trouble codes.

defaultVersions.changelog: PID updates, Torque Pro socket integration, and widescreen AA gauge layouts.

name: Widgets For Android Auto
author: ns130291
description: Display home screen widgets directly inside Android Auto, including weather forecasts, home automation switches, calendar agenda, and media controls.

defaultVersions.changelog: Widget resizing fixes, low-latency refresh, and multi-widget layout support.

name: Nav2Contacts
author: frankkienl
description: Seamlessly navigate to contact addresses directly from your Android Auto screen without needing to manually copy or type addresses.

defaultVersions.changelog: Contact search optimization, Google Maps and Waze deep link dispatching.
